referenceUse: Whole-image proportion and material/light comparison only. No photo RGB, radiance, depth, plate or 2D warp is used by the runtime.
continuation: Existing incomplete porch133-r01b and completed hall132 roof assembly are continued; no restart or shared-global-asset mutation.
geometry: Real 0.6–6.5mm rounded timber edges throughout the hall, pagoda and enclosing galleries. Actual face UV coordinates follow member grain at 1.45m longitudinal and 0.38m transverse texture repeat.
Front columns gain 7.2% central / 4.4% lateral shaft radius and 64 radial segments, with vertical metric grain. Existing plinth/landing/stair contacts stay at their exact datums.
Deep narrow dark window lattice replaces the tall gold grid: actual 2.82m recessed window frames, 19mm vertical / 18mm horizontal wood strips, lower timber waist panels.

Ten curved timber vault ribs occupy the existing recessed soffit. Existing 133 openwork gains joined thick folded leaves, secondary branches and raised floral bosses; fine shaft fittings are actual attached closed wood/gilt forms.

Native R01 detail exposed that the old vault occluded its ribs: R02 seats ten ribs 15–95mm below the vault, warms the actual soffit timber, adds a 430mm main ridge cap/apron and scales the actual suspended lantern bodies to0.80 while preserving their measured fascia suspension contacts.
R03 seats ridge medallions on the actual new ceramic apron front face, avoiding the R02 over-cladding occlusion. R01/R02 native candidates are retained.
materialAndLight: Existing generated cedar detail has stronger neutralized luminance and roughness variation, with 1.2–1.8mm bump and warmer lacquer. No new external bitmap.
Ceramic is darker neutral grey, with physical roughness0.43 and clearcoat0.16; actual tile geometry is retained.

Native sky fill0.27, environment0.12, exposure1.08 and display-sky radiance0.22 retain the actual directional sun vector/intensity, increasing under-eave hierarchy. Contact AO uses 0.32m radius, blend0.60; this is declared screen-space approximation.

camera.reason: Whole-building coverage and stair/roof framing already agree closely with the source. Preserve source-led low approach, rather than forcing a larger unfaithful crop.

physicalStudy: A new verified official all-attribute export and queue-rendered physical sky/Cycles frame is required for this source; old 131/R05 physical studies are not this source.
limits: Source dimensions and hidden joints remain single-view inferences.
Added ornamental forms approximate the source hierarchy; no claim of exact iconographic or structural reproduction.
Native WebGL fill/AO/reflection approximations are not Cycles material/light equivalence.
